title: Redmi Turbo 6 Max render showcases its fresh new design
description: Redmi launched the Turbo 5 Max in January, and it's already working on its successor, details about which first surfaced earlier this month. Today we also get to see its fresh, revamped design in the image you can see below. Gone is the left-aligned vertical camera island, as in its place we get a Pixel-like camera bar that runs across the top of the phone. The device is rumored to sport a 7-inch flat screen with a "2K" resolution and a 10,000 mAh battery, 1,000 mAh bigger than the one in its predecessor. The Turbo 6 Max is expected to be powered by the MediaTek Dimensity 9500s...

description: The vivo S2 is rumored to launch in India on August 6, with the company recently confirming its arrival and teasing the handset's design. Ahead of its debut, a new leak has revealed the phone's full specifications and expected pricing. The tipster adds that the handset will have a box price of INR 66,999. The vivo S2 is tipped to feature a 6.83-inch curved AMOLED display with a 1.5K resolution and a 120Hz refresh rate. title: Realme 16x Indian variant said to pack 7,000mAh battery, launch soon
description: According to a new leak, the Realme 16x 5G could soon make its debut in India. The Indian variant is tipped to feature a larger battery than the global variant. The handset was also recently spotted on the BIS certification website, hinting at an imminent launch. The leak claims that the India-bound Realme 16x will pack a 7,000mAh battery, replacing the 6,600mAh cell found in the global version. The leak suggests that the phone will be powered by the MediaTek Dimensity 6300 chipset and ship with Android 16 out of the box. It is also tipped to come with a 144Hz display, a 50MP...

title: Samsung Galaxy S26 FE's charging speed revealed via new certification
description: The Samsung Galaxy S26 FE - expected to arrive in September - has been spotted on the UL Demko certification database, revealing its charging speed. The listing mentions 15V/3A and 10V/4.5A charging ratings, indicating the S26 FE supports a maximum charging speed of 45W. That's the same as last year's Galaxy S25 FE and this year's Galaxy S26+, but slower than the Galaxy S26 Ultra (60W) and faster than the Galaxy S26 (25W). title: Moto Pad 70 Groove with 9 JBL speakers is launching this week
description: Motorola has announced the launch of its new Moto Pad 70 Groove tablet in India. The upcoming tablet will feature a 12.1-inch display, a 360-degree kickstand, and a 9 speaker JBL audio system. The Moto Pad 70 Groove is set to debut in India on July 31. If its design looks familiar, that's because it's essentially a rebadged Lenovo Tab Plus Gen 2. A Flipkart microsite for the Moto Pad 70 Groove is already live, revealing most of the tablet's key specifications. It will be powered by the MediaTek Dimensity 7400 chipset and pack a 10,200mAh battery. The tablet features a 12.1-inch...

title: Apple Home Hub smart speaker with a display is coming this year, here are its features
description: According to a new report from Bloomberg's Mark Gurman, Apple is planning to release the Home Hub as early as October, and as late as early next year. Unsurprisingly, the new Siri AI will be its main selling point. This device is basically a HomePod-like smart speaker with a 7-inch display. It will allegedly run an entirely new operating system based on Apple's tvOS, with the interface being a blend of tvOS, watchOS, and iOS. title: New leak claims the Pixel 11 and Pixel 11 Pro may actually be cheaper than their predecessors
description: A few days ago a Google exec confirmed that price hikes are coming to the entire Pixel lineup, including the Pixel 11 family which is due to be unveiled on August 12. Today, a usually reliable source has revealed the purported pricing for three of the Pixel 11 models for the UK market, and it's not all bad news. In fact, both the Pixel 11 and the Pixel 11 Pro will actually be cheaper than their predecessors - with a slight catch. The Pixel 11 will start at £879 with 256GB of storage. title: WhatsApp Web finally gets support for audio and video calls
description: Today WhatsApp is rectifying one of the major shortcomings of its web client, as it now finally supports audio and video calls. Obviously, this requires no download or installation, as it is part of WhatsApp Web, which has also gained support for screen sharing, reactions, and a dedicated Calls tab with your full call history and favorites. Like everywhere else on WhatsApp, the calls you make on WhatsApp Web are end-to-end encrypted, and have no time limits or costs. You can now also move a call from one device to another without having to hang up and start a new one. This works from the...

title: Samsung's smart glasses have this important privacy feature
description: During its Unpacked event earlier this month, Samsung unveiled its AI smart glasses powered by Android XR. We've already gone eyes-on with them, don't miss our dedicated article. Now it's been revealed that the glasses will come with an important privacy feature whenever they do finally go on sale. And of course it's related to the camera. Whenever the camera is active and capturing photos or videos, or when you're in a video call in apps like Google Meet, the LED indicator on the glasses will turn on. This indicator is visible both to the wearer and to anyone else around them. So...

title: HMD Asha 305 debuts as a "lite smartphone" with a removable battery
description: The HMD Asha 305 has been unveiled in the Philippines and is now available for purchase. Marketed as a "lite smartphone," it is claimed to offer a step up from a feature phone and comes with Android AOSP, more than 100 selected apps, a removable battery, and basic hardware. It is powered by a Unisoc T137 chipset, which is paired with 2GB of RAM and 16GB of onboard storage. Up front, the HMD Asha 305 features a 5-inch LCD display with a resolution of 480 × 854 pixels. title: Honor X7e Plus arrives with SD 4 Gen 4 and 8,100mAh battery
description: The Honor X7e Plus is now official, and it brings several improvements over the Honor X7e that launched back in May. The screen on the Plus model measures in at 6.87 inches, though it’s still a TFT LCD with a mere 720p resolution. In terms of battery, Honor bumped up the X7e Plus to an 8,100mAh cell, which is 600mAh more than the standard X7e. Charging is still capped at 45W speeds. title: New Apple Upgrade leasing program is live for iPhones, Apple Watches, iPads, and Macs
description: Last week a rumor claimed Apple would be replacing the iPhone Upgrade program with a new one called Apple Upgrade. This has now been officially announced by the company. Apple Upgrade is a new leasing program provided by Klarna. Through it you can get iPhones, Apple Watches, iPads, and Macs. Apple Upgrade is available on the Apple Store online, in the Apple Store app, and at Apple Stores in the US. title: Honor details Robot Phone cameras ahead of launch
description: Ahead of its long-anticipated debut, Honor held a dedicated event in China where it detailed the cameras inside its Robot Phone. As the first device in the partnership with legendary German cinema camera brand Arri, the Robot Phone brings several firsts. These include native Log-C3 video encoding, LUT color grading which is processed on the device and a dedicated Cinema mode which replicates the look and feel of Arri cinema cameras. title: Nvidia, Microsoft, Meta and others form Open Secure AI Alliance
description: The tech industry is still reeling from the recent Hugging Face incident, where an autonomous, rogue OpenAI model escaped its testing environment and hacked into Hugging Face's systems. Hugging Face tried unsuccessfully to defend itself by using leading US closed models like Anthropic's Fable 5 and was finally able to contain the breach using the open-weight GLM 5.2 by Chinese Z.ai. For context, closed models operate in their own closed environment (like ChatGPT); in contrast, open-weight AI models can be downloaded, modified, and run more easily. The incident has prompted tech industry...

title: iQOO Z11 to launch in India with a different processor, 3D curved display
description: iQOO introduced the Z11 Lite in India last week, and now a Gadgets360 report claims the company will launch the Z11 in the country in August. The publication also claims that the iQOO Z11 will launch in India with the Dimensity 7500 Turbo SoC, making it the first smartphone in the Asian country to have that chip under the hood. The Z11 launched in China is powered by the Dimensity 8500 SoC, while Malaysia got the Snapdragon 7s Gen 4. title: Redmi Note 17 India launch date confirmed
description: The Redmi Note 17 series finally has an official launch date for India. Just as previously speculated, the Note 17 and Note 17 Pro will be introduced on August 6. The accompanying teasers showcase the Note 17 in blue and purple colors.
